newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Buenos Aires bankruptcies rise in October.
newsitem.headline: Buenos Aires bankruptcies rise in October.

text.p: A total 144 firms went bankrupt in the Argentine capital in October, a 37 percent rise on September, and 3,559 bank accounts were cancelled, a 32 percent increase, credit risk consultant Fidelitas said Friday.
Bankruptcies in the January-October period totaled 945, a 41.6 percent more than in the same period last year. Bank account closures for bad-check writing rose three percent over the 10-month period.
The Argentine equivalent of Chapter 11 filings also increased in October, but in the 10-month period since January they dropped by 10 percent to 7,449 cases.
